goal: app1.sh and app2.sh each format their log line themselves and have drifted apart: app1 prints `[info] <message>` while app2 prints `INFO: <message>`. Both must print exactly `[info] <message>`. Refactor the shared formatting into a single sourced helper file `lib/log.sh` (run from the repository root) and make both scripts use it, so the format can no longer diverge.
